card.name: Food-handling and sterile-prep wording
card.fires_on: Words inside safe handling or cooking instructions, such as 'and' in meat-roast lists, 'safety' in biological safety cabinet, and 'of' after Dispose. It also fires partway through biosafety and butcher words.
